verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right flow (logo, product, headline, CTA), but the body copy and badges are tiny. The SUNSET SALE ribbon crowds the end of the headline, and the SMALL BATCH badge drops onto its own orphaned row. The missing-asset placeholder box is still visible. B blows the headline up until it jams against the top and right edges and overpowers the CTA. Its badges and SUNSET SALE ribbon are scattered in a jumbled cluster with no grid, the body copy is cramped, the legal text is illegible at right, and the placeholder box is still there, so B is the less coherent of the two.
